# Which sample card suits a small case

The Example Card 900 fits a small case and has 24 GB of memory. It is the card to pick when the case is the
limit.

## What the card gives you

The Example Card 900 has 24 GB of memory. The older Example Card 700 has 16 GB of memory.

| Card | Memory |
|---|---|
| Example Card 900 | 24 GB |
| Example Card 700 | 16 GB |

More on memory in [LINK: how much memory a card needs -> memory guide].
